verified_combinations.evidence: internal semantic tests; LOCK is excluded by the pinned vector source

source_findings.source: Intel, The 8086 Family User's Manual, October 1979, section 2-42
source_findings.finding: When a repeated string with multiple prefixes is interrupted, the processor remembers only the prefix immediately before the string instruction. Other prefixes are not restored on return.

source_findings.source: Intel, ASM86 Language Reference Manual 121703-003, November 1983, section 6-81
source_findings.finding: The effect of using more than one prefix is processor-dependent; the manual directs readers to the manual for the target processor.

decision.a10_scope: Do not infer cycle-level behavior for prefix sequences absent from the pinned hardware vectors. The documented multi-prefix interrupted-string limitation is recorded; interrupt-resume behavior belongs to A11 and must be tested there.
unverified_and_deferred_to_a12: Repeated copies of the same prefix
Other orderings of segment, LOCK and REP/REPNE
Cycle traces for multi-prefix forms excluded from the pinned source
decision.runtime_behavior: These sequences remain explicit known gaps. No claim of hardware support or cycle accuracy is made.
